title: I made a text based life sim for my first project with the help of Claude
author: DesperateWrongdoer96
selftext:
Yooo what’s up hope all is well !! So as the title stated I made text based life sim titled “New Life” which I initially started in Replit, but then transferred it to Claude. I played many life sims and noticed all the paywalls which as an indie developer I get, but micro transactions have become predatory in the gaming industry/community. So I made a life sim with depth and no main functions behind paywalls. Keep developing, learning, and growing,and pushing the envelope with your projects oh and ignore the basement dwelling keyboard warriors on this app who don’t contribute anything but miserable comments lol I’m rooting for everyone who’s passionate about developing !! 🙌🏾 here’s the link if you want to try it out:

https://locomuse.itch.io/new-life

comments.author: Colonel-James-Parker
comments.body:
Wish you success on your project. 

Just know that UI/UX looks too AI slop. It was one of the things I learned when I was making my first app. Focus on different type of designs, don't let the AI to design it for you. 

Try other image generators with prompts. Also you can use [https://impeccable.style/visual-mode/#try-it-live](https://impeccable.style/visual-mode/#try-it-live) to teach design skill for Claude/Codex.

replies.author: DesperateWrongdoer96
replies.body: Yea it was my first project some people cared some didn’t snd the game hasn’t been out but a month. So it’ll have more changes..also working on something better now that I know more. Not new to developing just new to  LLMs honestly. Appreciate the help and constructive criticism and I wish you success on yours projects as well !! 🫡
